TEMPLATE_GALLERY.TITLE: Templates
TEMPLATE_GALLERY.LEAD: Choose an occasion: every template comes with words, colours, fonts and a 3D motif, and you can change all of it to suit you.

DESCRIPTION.MUTTERTAG: A bouquet of flowers and a big thank-you to Mom.
DESCRIPTION.VALENTINSTAG: A heart and a few loving lines for your favourite person.
DESCRIPTION.GEBURTSTAG: Cake, confetti and the very best wishes for the year ahead.
DESCRIPTION.WEIHNACHTEN: A snow globe full of winter magic for the people you love.
DESCRIPTION.HOCHZEIT: Champagne and heartfelt congratulations for the happy couple.

HOME.LEAD: Pick a template, write your words and place a 3D gift inside – a bouquet, a cake, a heart. Whoever opens your billet turns it with a finger and discovers it from every side. Shared by link, no app needed.
HOME.STEP_TEMPLATE_TEXT: Mother’s Day, birthday, wedding – you start from a finished design.
HOME.STEP_DESIGN_TEXT: Adjust the text, colours, fonts and the 3D model in the editor.
HOME.STEP_SHARE_TEXT: With an account you publish your billet and send the link on.

BILLETS.TITLE: My billets
BILLETS.LEAD: Every billet you have designed, in one place.
BILLETS.EMPTY_TEXT: As soon as you design a billet, it appears here. Without an account, your billets stay on this device.
BILLETS.DEVICE_NOTE: Your billets are stored in this browser, on this device only. With an account you can keep them safe and share them.
BILLETS.DELETE_MESSAGE: “{{title}}” will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
BILLETS.ACCOUNT_EMPTY_TEXT: As soon as you design a billet, it appears here, safe in your account.
BILLETS.LOAD_FAILED: Your billets could not be loaded.
BILLETS.DELETE_ACCOUNT_MESSAGE: “{{title}}” will be deleted from your account. This cannot be undone.
BILLETS.DELETE_PUBLISHED_MESSAGE: “{{title}}” will be deleted from your account, and its link stops working. This cannot be undone.

IMPORT.TITLE_ONE: 1 billet is only on this device
IMPORT.TITLE_OTHER: {{count}} billets are only on this device
IMPORT.TEXT: In your account you can share your billets and keep editing them on any device.
IMPORT.NO_ROOM: Your account does not have room for all of them: {{free}} of {{max}} places are free. Delete billets you no longer need, then they all fit.
IMPORT.REFUSED: Your account did not have room for all of them. Delete billets you no longer need and try again.

SAVE_STATUS.REJECTED: Not saved – kept on this device

EDITOR.SHARE_GUEST_HINT: Sign in to share your billet.
EDITOR.SHARE_DEVICE_HINT: Move the billet into your account to share it.
EDITOR.NOT_FOUND_TEXT: This billet does not exist in this browser (any more). It may have been deleted or created on another device.
EDITOR.NOT_FOUND_ACCOUNT_TEXT: This billet is not in your account (any more). It may have been deleted.
EDITOR.LOAD_FAILED: The billet could not be loaded.
EDITOR.LEAVE_UNSAVED: Your latest changes could not be saved. If you leave now, they are lost.

REMOTE.CHANGED: This billet was changed in another tab while you were working on it here.
REMOTE.REMOVED: This billet was deleted in another tab.
REMOTE.CONFLICT: This billet was changed elsewhere while you were working on it here.
REMOTE.BACKUP: This device holds newer changes to this billet that are not saved yet.

DEVICE.TITLE: This billet is only on this device
DEVICE.TEXT: Move it into your account to share it and keep editing on any device.
DEVICE.FULL: Your account has no room left. Delete a billet there, then you can move this one in.

CONTENT.PAGE_TITLE_HINT: Shown in the recipient's browser tab. Leave it empty to use the heading.
CONTENT.ADD_BLOCK_HINT: A new block goes after the one you last worked on.
CONTENT.BLOCKS_LIMIT: A billet has at most {{max}} blocks.
CONTENT.BLOCKS_EMPTY: No blocks yet. Add a paragraph, a card or a note.
CONTENT.MARKUP_HINT: *italic* and **bold**; an empty line starts a new paragraph.
CONTENT.CARD_ARIA_LABEL_HINT: Read out by screen readers before the card.
CONTENT.SPACE_ADJUST_HINT: Steps more or less than the usual space.
CONTENT.REMOVED: {{type}} deleted – Undo brings the block back.

DESIGN.THEME_HINT: A theme sets your billet's colours, fonts and particle colours. You can adjust everything afterwards.
DESIGN.COLOR_MODE_HINT: Automatic follows the setting of the device your billet is opened on.
DESIGN.DARK_LINKED_HINT: Every change to the light colours creates the dark ones anew.
DESIGN.DARK_DERIVED: These colours are derived from the light ones. Turn off “Derive dark automatically” to adjust them yourself.
DESIGN.DARK_PREVIEW_HINT: Set the preview above to “Dark” to see these colours in the billet.
DESIGN.ACCENT_NOTE: The line above the title is accent on soft accent. It is decorative text, so a contrast of 3 : 1 is enough.
DESIGN.FONT_PAIRS_HINT: Takes the fonts of a theme; your colours stay.

FONT_ROLE_HINTS.TITLE: First line of the title.
FONT_ROLE_HINTS.TITLE_ACCENT: Second line of the title. Its size is relative to the title.
FONT_ROLE_HINTS.HEADING: Heading blocks.
FONT_ROLE_HINTS.UI: The lines above and below the title, the 3D hint and the line below the signature.

DESIGN.ITALIC_UNAVAILABLE: This font has no italic at this weight.
DESIGN.EMPHASIS_HINT: For *italic* text in paragraphs, cards and notes.

SPACING.INTRO: Spacing moves in fixed steps. The arrow next to a value resets it to the original card.
SPACING.GUTTER_HINT: Space to the left and right of the content.
SPACING.HERO_TOP_HINT: Room between the top of the page and the title.
SPACING.HERO_BOTTOM_HINT: Room between the header and the 3D model.
SPACING.SCENE_HEIGHT_HINT: How much room the 3D model gets.
SPACING.DIVIDER_GAP_HINT: Space above and below the divider between the 3D area and the text.
SPACING.BLOCK_GAP_HINT: The usual space before each block. Adjust single blocks under Content.
SPACING.SIGNATURE_GAP_HINT: Space between the last block and the signature.

SCENE.DISABLED_HINT: Without a 3D model the text follows right after the header.
SCENE.LIBRARY_ERROR: The models could not be loaded.
SCENE.MODEL_HINT: Another model brings its own size, camera and exposure.
SCENE.RETIRED: This model is no longer in the library. It stays in your billet until you choose another one.
SCENE.STAGE_HINT: The preview shows every change right away.
SCENE.HINT_HINT: Leave empty to show no hint.
SCENE.ARIA_LABEL_HINT: Say briefly what the model shows, especially after changing the model.

PARTICLES.TITLE: Particles
PARTICLES.REDUCED_MOTION: Anyone who has turned on “Reduce motion” on their device sees no particles.
PARTICLES.COLORS_HINT: Each particle gets one of these colours at random. Up to {{max}} are possible.

NEW_BILLET.FULL_TITLE: No room left in your account
NEW_BILLET.FULL_TEXT: You have reached the maximum number of billets. Delete one you no longer need, then try again.
NEW_BILLET.FAILED: Your billet could not be created.

SHARE.TITLE: Share “{{title}}”
SHARE.EXPLAIN: Publishing gives your billet a link. It shows a snapshot: whatever you change afterwards stays private until you choose “Publish changes”.
SHARE.RESHARE: You have shared this billet before. If you publish it again, the earlier link works again too.
SHARE.LINK_HINT: Anyone with this link can view your billet.
SHARE.CURRENT: The link shows the current version. Whatever you change from now on stays private until you publish it.
SHARE.CHANGED: You have changed something since publishing. The link still shows the earlier version.
SHARE.UNPUBLISH_MESSAGE: The link will no longer show your billet. If you publish it again later, the same link works again.

STATUS.UNPUBLISHED: Your billet is no longer shared.
STATUS.SELECTED: The link is selected. Copy it with Ctrl+C (Mac: ⌘+C).

AUTH.LOGIN_LEAD: Log in to save your billets online and share them.
AUTH.REGISTER_LEAD: With an account, your billets are stored safely online and can be shared via link.
AUTH.NAME: Name
AUTH.NAME_HINT: How you appear in the app.
AUTH.PASSWORD_HINT: At least {{min}} characters, with upper- and lowercase letters and a digit.
AUTH.FORGOT_PASSWORD_LEAD: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to set a new password.

AUTH.RESET_PASSWORD_LEAD: Choose a new password for your account.
AUTH.INVALID_RESET_LINK_TEXT: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

AUTH.EMAIL_INVALID: Please enter a valid email address.
AUTH.PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS: Use at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit.

ACCOUNT.TITLE: My account
ACCOUNT.LEAD: Manage your profile, your password and your account.
ACCOUNT.LOAD_FAILED: Your account could not be loaded.
ACCOUNT.NAME: Name
ACCOUNT.EMAIL_READONLY_HINT: Your email address cannot be changed.
ACCOUNT.LANGUAGE_HINT: The language of the interface and of the emails we send you.
ACCOUNT.AVATAR_HINT: JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP or AVIF, up to 20 MB.
ACCOUNT.AVATAR_DROP: You can also drop an image here.
ACCOUNT.PASSWORD_SECTION_LEAD: After the change you will be logged out on all other devices.
ACCOUNT.DEACTIVATE_LEAD: Your account will be deactivated and permanently deleted after 30 days, including all billets. If you log in again before then, everything is kept.

ADMIN_USERS.TITLE: Users
ADMIN_USERS.LOAD_FAILED: The users could not be loaded.
ADMIN_USERS.NAME: Name

ADMIN_USERS.ACTIVE_SELF_HINT: You cannot lock your own account.

NOT_FOUND.TITLE: Page not found
NOT_FOUND.TEXT: This page does not exist, or no longer does. Perhaps there is a typo in the address.

PUBLIC_BILLET.NOT_FOUND_TEXT: The link may be incomplete, or the billet has been withdrawn. It is best to ask the person who sent it to you.
PUBLIC_BILLET.FAILED_TITLE: This billet cannot be opened right now
PUBLIC_BILLET.FAILED_TEXT: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

FOOTER.TAGLINE: Design billets and share them with a link.

UI_KIT.TITLE: UI kit
UI_KIT.LEAD: Every building block of the design system in the fixed Studio design, then the billet themes – for visual checks in light and dark.
UI_KIT.SITE_LEAD: The fixed design of every page outside the editor. Switch between light and dark in the header.
UI_KIT.BILLET_THEMES_LEAD: A theme is a design preset for the billet: it applies only to the preview and the published page, never to the interface. The theme picker shows each preset as a small billet, here in light and dark; below are the colours and fonts a theme writes into a billet.
UI_KIT.SUBHEADING_SAMPLE: Design it, share it, make someone smile
UI_KIT.BODY_SAMPLE: Billets are small digital cards with text, colours and a 3D motif. You design them in the editor and share them with a link.
UI_KIT.HINT_SAMPLE: Muted helper text for side notes.
UI_KIT.BUTTONS_DISABLED: Disabled: keeps the variant colour, muted
UI_KIT.BUTTONS_PENDING: Action running: spinner instead of the icon, pending label, disabled
UI_KIT.PROGRESS: Global activity: the bar under the header (running here all the time)
UI_KIT.HINT_NAME: This is how your name appears on the billet.
UI_KIT.ALERT_WARNING: You are offline. Changes stay on this device for now.
UI_KIT.ALERT_DANGER: The billet could not be loaded.
UI_KIT.DIALOG_BODY: The billet and its shared link will be removed. This cannot be undone.
UI_KIT.POPOVER_BODY: Use *asterisks* for italics and **two** for bold.
UI_KIT.CARD_BODY: A bunch of tulips, warm colours and a few kind lines.
UI_KIT.CARD_NEW_BODY: Start from a template or a blank page.
UI_KIT.PRESET_SAMPLE_BODY: for everything no book could teach me – and for all your patience.
